positions.title: Research Assistant - Jet Engine Conversion Project
positions.locationName: Ann Arbor, Michigan, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Reverse-engineered black box kerosene jet engine controller

Prototyped and developed a microcontroller-based system implementing control loops, emergency procedures, sensor reading, and Wi-Fi-based communications

Designed a PCB to simplify and shrink new control system to fit jet enclosure

Led CAD team (4 People) for hydrogen conversion parts
positions.insights: Skills: Control Systems Design · Reverse Engineering · System Deployment · Cross-functional Team Leadership

company.name: University of Michigan College of Engineering

positions.title: Test Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Constructed and programmed a robust control system under NDA

Created professional wiring schematics to facilitate assembly and troubleshooting in case of shipping or testing process damage

Implemented monitoring software to track cycle count and sensor wear, providing accurate feedback even in the event of hardware failures
positions.insights: Skills: Hardware Testing · Wiring Diagrams · Control Systems Design · Test Automation

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Designed and implemented an automated archival file ingest and conversion system, processing approximately 13,000 files into digital forms.

Collected and compiled process and equipment data for review

Automation of Microsoft Office suite products
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analysis · Process Improvement Projects · Software Architecture · Powershell

positions.description:
Compile, record, and publish broadcast of weekly service

Handle audio balancing and interfacing of external audio equipment
